features.title: Your rules and source notes
features.description: Start Custom, DND or Warhammer projects. Upload Markdown context and develop characters, scenery, worlds and a rulebook with one companion.

features.title: Choose how AI is funded
features.description: Link ChatGPT for conversation, see recorded account and API tokens separately, and set a project text token limit. Image generation requires an OpenAI API key; upload your own art for Meshy instead.

features.title: A rulebook you can share
features.description: Edit cover, contents and chapters, turn preview pages and export PDF or HTML. Player exports keep private chapters and source notes out.

features.title: Relevant context, controlled usage
features.description: The whole campaign stays local. Requests include only relevant excerpts and recent dialogue within a bounded project context.
